name: Keeton Martin
intro: I'm a software engineer at [Range](https://range.com), building an AI wealth assistant that works across iMessage and the web. I designed and shipped its proactive execution system, helping it follow up, review a household’s finances, and reach out when something needs attention.

On the side I build Railwatch, an Amtrak tracker, and Incolia, a platform for persistent AI agents. I also tinker with tiny keyboards. Before Range I spent three years at Salesforce. I studied computer science at Haverford.

route.title: Software Engineer, AI and Investments
route.note: Designed and shipped the proactive execution system for Range’s AI wealth assistant on web and iMessage. Built background workflows with safe retries, consent and quiet-hours controls, plus end-to-end evaluations for useful outreach and knowing when to stay quiet. Improved agent memory and iMessage reliability, and shipped full-stack brokerage and advisor tools.

route.title: Member of Technical Staff
route.note: Flow features in Automation Services, in TypeScript and Java. Led a greenfield ETL product from zero to 1.2M transactions in six months. Promoted in 2024; mentored an intern.
